source_ownership.stem_and_patterns: PG899 positive M/N tvat with marut/jagat ownership
source_ownership.address_exclusion: PG899 retains first ownership of the six M/N vocative keys

construction.masculine_pattern: exact marut row transport to t-final tvat
construction.neuter_pattern: printed jagat NOM/ACC rows plus explicit remainder-as-marut transport
construction.voicing_route: printed marudbh- corresponds to tvadbh- before bh-initial endings

source_observations: the marut nominative row has marut, marutau and marutah
the marut accusative row has marutam, marutau and marutah
the marut instrumental row has maruta, marudbhyam and marudbhih
the marut dative row has marute, marudbhyam and marudbhyah
the marut ablative row has marutah, marudbhyam and marudbhyah
the marut genitive row has marutah, marutoh and marutam
the marut locative row has maruti, marutoh and marutsu
the jagat nominative row has jagat, jagati and jaganti
the jagat accusative row has jagat, jagati and jaganti
the source states that the remainder follows marut
the neuter instrumental therefore follows the marut row
the neuter dative therefore follows the marut row
the neuter ablative and genitive therefore follow the marut rows
the neuter locative therefore follows the marut row
source_policy_decisions: Transport all seven printed non-vocative marut rows to masculine tvat under PG899 ownership.
Transport the printed jagat NOM/ACC rows and the expressly inherited marut remainder to neuter tvat.
Preserve voiced tvadbh-, gender/case/number syncretisms and first-owner exclusions; credit no literary, accent, Vedic or competing-policy evidence.
